documents.title: User stories — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live
documents.body:
# User stories — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live

## Personas

- **The public reader** — opens `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/` with no account and reads the studio pack and its generated standards artefacts.
- **The outside contributor** — challenges a published output through GitHub Discussions or an Issue, so feedback is recorded in the repository the pack is published from.
- **The tenant operator** — signs into the design origin and drives the real card loop from the console: intake, move, comment, claim, release.
- **The delivery lead** — reads a project's workspace: board, plan, linked issues, text outputs and Publish.
- **The standards author** — composes a project's expected outputs and reads the generated MSP/TOGAF/SAFe/PMP artefacts under `docs/standards/`.
- **The design author** — maintains the pack (`studio.html`, `v2.js`/`v2.css`, the enterprise, learning and architecture modules) and its checks.

## Stories

- As the public reader, I want `/design` served from the conveyor app image with `/design` redirecting to `/design/`, so the SPEC_V2 model is inspectable without an account and without any API call.
- As the design author, I want the pack tracked in the repository and gated by the headless-Chrome passes, so the published site cannot drift from the committed source.
- As the tenant operator, I want to sign in on the design origin with auth-code plus PKCE S256 against realm `conveyor` and public client `conveyor-web`, so the Plan Boards tab and the Projects workspace send the real action requests and never simulate them.
- As the delivery lead, I want the conveyor's own rows to be the source of truth — programme `conveyor-buildout`, one project per current plan, the GitHub issue registry linked per project — so the site renders live data under a LIVE ribbon naming the payload hash, timestamp and git sha.
- As the standards author, I want every programme project to declare its expected outputs and each generated artefact to render its named rows or a fixed absent line, so an absent or partial mandatory artefact names the rework package that must close.
- As the outside contributor, I want to raise feedback as a GitHub Discussion or Issue, so a challenge to a published output becomes a recorded contribution.

## Scenarios

- Given a request for `/design` without the trailing slash, when the static handler resolves it to a directory with its own `index.html`, then the slashless form redirects and the slash form serves the pack's index, while every other extensionless SPA path is unchanged.
- Given the public snapshot — signed out, or a checkout whose `snapshot.js` is the placeholder — when the page loads, then it makes zero API requests and the data gate reports DESIGN mode and exits 0; only the theme preference survives a reload.
- Given the operator console signed in, when the Plan Boards tab renders the tenant's projects, boards and cards and a control is used, then the intake, move, comment, claim and release requests are sent and the 401 and 412 paths are rendered rather than retried.
- Given the image's web stage copies the generated documents and the data directory beside the runtime files, when the console opens its Documents destination, then the document pages and data links resolve.
- Given a snapshot payload, when `check-data.cjs` runs, then the manifest schema, every file's SHA-256 and byte length, the secret-metadata-only rule, the absence of emails and credential-shaped strings, and the load order of the snapshot before `v2.js` are verified.
- Given a mandatory artefact whose decision nobody made, when the generator publishes, then the artefact is the fixed absent line naming the record that would satisfy it, never an invented body.
- Given the eight closed units, when the tranche-0 review runs, then the project meets its acceptance with published evidence.

## Verify

- `node docs/design/scripts/check-studio.cjs` — 233 checks (measured 2026-11-16).
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-learning.cjs` — 139 checks.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs` — 180 checks.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-workbench.cjs` — 119 checks.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-architecture.cjs` — 146 checks.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-data.cjs` — the generated-data gate; DESIGN mode exits 0.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs` — the signed-out and signed-in console gate.
- `git diff --check`.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md` — Files and boundaries, Two surfaces, Verification.
- Units: #32, #33, #36, #37, #89, #97, #103, #149.
- Record: the DESIGN-PUBLISH project row; benefit B4 and outcome O6.

## Notes

Reconstructed from the programme record on 2026-11-28 for standard v4. The project row is closed with `measured_status: built`; this document is the Delivery narrative the standard asks for, not a new claim.

documents.body:
# Acceptance criteria — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live

## Scenarios

- The pack is served live: `https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/` returns the studio pack from the conveyor app image, `/design` redirects to `/design/`, and `nonagentic.ai/design` 308-redirects to this site.
- The pack is tracked in the repository, including the System architecture page and its committed Mermaid SVG pairs, and the headless-Chrome passes are green.
- The signed-out pack makes zero API requests; the signed-in console sends the intake, move, comment, claim and release requests, and renders 401 and 412 rather than retrying.
- The image's web stage copies the generated documents and the data directory, so the console's Documents destination and data links resolve.
- The data gate verifies the manifest schema, every file's SHA-256 and byte length, the secret-metadata-only rule, the absence of emails and credential-shaped strings, and that `studio.html` loads the snapshot before `v2.js`; with the placeholder it reports DESIGN mode and exits 0.
- The conveyor's own rows are the source of truth: one programme `conveyor-buildout`, one project per current plan, the registered GitHub issues linked per project, and a deterministic full-public-except-secrets snapshot.
- Feedback is GitHub Discussions and Issues, reachable from the published pages.
- Every programme project declares `meta.expected_outputs`; the console renders expected against present per project and marks the first missing row as next. The rule is by project kind: `S##` gets `[project-brief]`; `T##` gets `[project-brief, analysis, architecture]`; `PLATFORM`, `SPEC-V2` and `DESIGN-PUBLISH` get `[project-brief]`; P0 gets its eight categories.
- The V2 registration is true in the design index and the programme seed, and the tranches are derived from the plan and published.
- The live engine proof (A5) runs against the deployed revision.
- A mandatory artefact whose decision nobody made is published as the fixed absent line, never invented.
- A generated-data gate failure on any of the above is a red check, not a warning.

## Verify commands

- `node docs/design/scripts/check-studio.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-learning.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-workbench.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-architecture.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-data.cjs`
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs`
- `python3 scripts/build-programme-seed.py --check`
- `python3 scripts/build-coverage.py --check`
- `python3 scripts/check-output-standard.py`
- `python3 scripts/audit-programme-conformance.py --self-test`
- `curl -sI https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design` and `curl -s https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/`
- `git diff --check`

## Results

Met at the project baseline and re-checked for this record. All eight units (#32, #33, #36, #37, #89, #97, #103, #149) are closed in the issue registry. #32 landed the pack in the repository, taught the static handler to serve a directory sub-site and published it in the image; #33, #36 and #37 made the conveyor's own rows the source of truth and published the build surface with sanitation, docs-as-HTML and feedback links; #89 made the V2 registration true in the index and the programme seed; #103 derived the tranches and published the truth; #149 added the expected-outputs rule and the project checklist; #97 proved the engine live against the deployed revision. The six Chrome passes, the console gate and the data gate are green at the counts recorded in the plan's Verification section (233, 139, 180, 119 and 146 checks plus the two gates, measured 2026-11-16). The live tenant still had no run and no approval row at closure, so the Execution room renders an honest empty queue until one starts; binary artefacts and object storage remain a separate unit. Both are stated limits, not misses.

## Status

met — the eight units closed, the pack is served live and the data and console gates hold. The tranche-0 review decision (continue, pause or stop) belongs to the sponsoring group's record, not to this project.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md` — Verification, Two surfaces, Files and boundaries.
- Units: #32, #33, #36, #37, #89, #97, #103, #149.
- Record: the DESIGN-PUBLISH project row; benefit B4; outcome O6.

documents.title: Definition of ready — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live

## Independent

DESIGN-PUBLISH carries `depends_on: []` in `seed/programme.json` — it has no incoming dependency. The eight units were delivered in sequence over one shared pack rather than file-disjoint: #32 lands the pack and serves it, #33 makes the conveyor's rows the source, #36 and #37 publish the build surface and flip the repository public, #89 keeps the V2 registration true, #97 proves the engine live, #103 derives the tranches, and #149 adds expected outputs and the checklist. Each later unit rebased on the earlier ones, so the independence is at the dependency level, not at the file level.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed: the SPEC_V2 studio design pack served live from the conveyor app image, the site rendering the conveyor's own rows, and feedback through GitHub. The order and shape of the units, and the way the SPA, the sub-site and the console share one origin, were settled at delivery against the plan.

## Valuable

The named gap: the SPEC_V2 model existed only as untracked pack files and the site's SPA swallowed `/design`, so the public could neither read nor challenge the design. The project maps to B4, public collaboration — at least one outside contribution changes a published output and every output is reachable — through O6, the public can see and challenge the design, to the strategic objective of a public repository and published outputs. The DESIGN-PUBLISH public site is the capability reference in that benefit link.

## Estimable

The plan, `docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md`, names every file and every check, and each unit named its files and its verify command. The baseline was measured 2026-11-12: the live root was byte-identical to the committed `index.html`, `/design` returned the SPA index, and `.dockerignore` excluded `docs/`.

## Small

One issue per unit, eight units in all (#32, #33, #36, #37, #89, #97, #103, #149), each with one branch and one PR. This is a programme-track project rather than one slice, and each unit's scope is one surface: the pack and its route, the snapshot and feedback, the public build surface, the registration, the live proof, the tranche derivation, the expected outputs.

## Testable

Every part of every unit carries a Given/When/Then scenario with a `Verify:` command. The six headless-Chrome passes, the console gate and the data gate are the project-level tests, and the live routes are checkable with a request for `/design` and `/design/`.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: none — `depends_on: []`.
- blocks: the tranche-0 exit, which also requires P0, PLATFORM, S00, S01, SPEC-V2 and T0 to meet their acceptance with published evidence.
- related: P0 publishes the programme definition set on the same site; SPEC_V2 is the specification the pack draws.

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28 from the project row, the plan and the closed units.

documents.body:
# Definition of done — Publish the SPEC_V2 studio design pack, live

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Verify |
|---|---|
| `/design` is served from the conveyor app image and redirects to `/design/` | `curl -sI https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design`; `curl -s https://conveyor.nonagentic.ai/design/` |
| The pack is tracked and the headless-Chrome passes are green | the five `check-*.cjs` passes; `git diff --check` |
| Signed-out makes zero API requests; signed-in sends the real action requests and renders 401 and 412 | `node docs/design/scripts/check-console.cjs` |
| The data gate holds: schema, per-file hash and length, secret metadata only, no emails or credential shapes, snapshot load order; placeholder exits 0 | `node docs/design/scripts/check-data.cjs` |
| The conveyor's rows are the source: programme `conveyor-buildout`, one project per plan, issue links, deterministic full-public-except-secrets snapshot, LIVE ribbon hash and sha | the #33 and #37 evidence; `check-v2.cjs` signed-in boards |
| Feedback resolves as GitHub Discussions and Issues | the #36 evidence |
| Every project declares `expected_outputs`; the checklist marks the first missing row as next; the rule is by project kind | `python3 scripts/build-programme-seed.py --check`; `check-v2.cjs` |
| The V2 registration is true in the index and the seed, and the tranches are derived and published | the #89 and #103 evidence; `python3 scripts/build-coverage.py --check` |
| The live engine proof (A5) ran against the deployed revision | the #97 evidence |
| A mandatory artefact needing an unmade decision is published as the absent line, never invented | `python3 scripts/check-output-standard.py`; the generated pages under `docs/standards/` |

## Evidence at completion

All eight issues are closed in the registry. The project row reads `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, `tranche: 0`, `adm_phase: Preliminary`, `plateau: definition`, with `depends_on: []`. The check counts recorded in the plan's Verification section are 233, 139, 180, 119 and 146 (measured 2026-11-16) plus the data and console gates, all green. The live route serves the pack and the placeholder snapshot exits 0. The Execution room's empty queue and the absent binary artefacts are stated limits carried in the plan, not silent omissions.

## Repo gate

The project's gates are the six Chrome passes, the console gate, the data gate, `python3 scripts/build-programme-seed.py --check`, `python3 scripts/build-coverage.py --check`, `python3 scripts/check-output-standard.py`, `python3 scripts/audit-programme-conformance.py --self-test`, `git diff --check`, and the image build. The compile and lint verdict for the handler change is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the unit's PR CI; the historical local `rbuild` route is retired and is not a gate.

## Merge and closure

Each unit closed by its own PR and its branch was deleted. The project closed at tranche 0, and the tranche-0 review — continue, pause or stop — is the sponsoring group's separate act, not a merge in this project. The closure output the project owes is the `closure-review`; the project's own record is the closed row.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/design/STUDIO-SPEC.md`; units #32, #33, #36, #37, #89, #97, #103, #149.
- Record: the DESIGN-PUBLISH project row; benefit B4; outcome O6.
